ApiPhloCapabilities

Documentation / API / phlo / capabilities

Capability primitives and registry for Phlo.

This module provides the capability system that enables runtime feature discovery and dependency injection. Capabilities abstract concrete implementations of features like query engines, table stores, and authentication providers.

The capability system allows Phlo to:

  • Register and discover implementations at runtime
  • Resolve capabilities based on configuration and availability
  • Provide a unified interface for diverse backends
  • Support plugin-based extensibility

Key Concepts:

  • Capability: An abstract feature (e.g., "query_engine")
  • Provider: A concrete implementation (e.g., TrinoQueryEngine)
  • Specification: Configuration for a capability instance
  • Registry: Thread-safe storage for capability specifications
  • Resolution: Selecting the best available provider

Capability Types:

  • query_engine: SQL query execution (Trino, DuckDB, etc.)
  • table_store: Table storage (Iceberg, Delta, etc.)
  • catalog: Metadata catalog (Nessie, OpenMetadata, etc.)
  • object_store: Object storage (MinIO, S3, etc.)
  • authentication: User authentication providers
  • authorization: Policy-based access control
  • observability: Metrics and monitoring backends
  • alert_sink: Alert notification destinations
  • quality_backend: Data quality validation
  • schema_migrator: Schema evolution management
  • maintenance_read_model: Maintenance status tracking

Main Components:

  • :class:CapabilityRegistry: Thread-safe capability storage
  • :func:get_capability_registry: Access the global registry
  • :func:resolve_capability: Resolve a capability to a provider
  • :func:register_capability: Register capability implementations
  • :class:CapabilitySupport: Declare operational guarantees
  • :class:RuntimeContext: Context for capability resolution

BackupContributor

A provider-owned backup contributor (ADR 0049 §3).

The contributor receives an explicit destination (its owned staging prefix) and an operation ID, writes only beneath that prefix, returns artifact descriptors, and never finalizes the set.

contribute

RestoreContributor

A provider-owned restorer applying only its own artifacts to a target.

restore records before/after evidence and the phase; a failure before submission is never retry-safe. reconcile returns explicit post-restore checks across the provider's authority. Providers read their own verified artifacts from backup_set_dir and write under target.

restore

Apply this provider's artifacts to target.

reconcile

Return post-restore evidence; must include ok and reasons.

Provider-neutral executor for scoped table maintenance operations.

Return an executor whose backend connection targets ref.

Compact one table on the explicitly selected ref.

SchemaMigrator

Protocol for storage-layer schema migration providers.

Each storage provider (Iceberg, Delta, Hudi) implements this protocol and determines its own classification rules based on its capabilities.

supported_changes

Return the set of change_type values this provider supports natively.

classify_change

Classify a single change as 'safe', 'warning', or 'breaking'.

diff_schema

Compare desired schema against current table and produce a migration plan.

apply_plan

Execute a migration plan. Breaking changes require approved=True.

get_schema_history

Return schema version history for a table.

SchemaPolicyTableStore

Optional write-policy contract for stores advertising schema_policies.

Additive writes add nullable fields only, never migrate existing definitions. Advertised policies must be accepted by every supported write operation. Runtime protocol checks do not validate signatures; callers also check the selected methods before sending a policy keyword.

ensure_table

Validate a declaration without publishing additive evolution.

append_parquet

Validate and append using an advertised schema policy.

merge_parquet

Validate and merge using an advertised schema policy.

overwrite_parquet

Validate and overwrite if the provider supports replacement.

TableStore

Protocol for table-store providers used by ingestion components.

Required methods: ensure_table, append_parquet, merge_parquet. Extended operations (overwrite_parquet, delete_rows, compact, list_snapshots, rollback_to_snapshot, vacuum) raise NotImplementedError by default so providers opt in incrementally.

Properties

support → TableStoreSupport

Return explicit support metadata for this table-store adapter.

ensure_table

Ensure a destination table exists.

append_parquet

Append staged parquet data to a destination table.

merge_parquet

Merge staged parquet data into a destination table.

deduplication_method ("first"/"last") and deduplication_order_by control deterministic batch-local deduplication of rows sharing unique_key. Providers that cannot honor an explicitly requested option must reject it loudly rather than silently ignoring it.

overwrite_parquet

Overwrite a table with staged parquet data.

delete_rows

Delete rows matching a predicate expression.

compact

Compact small files in a table.

list_snapshots

List recent table snapshots for time-travel queries.

rollback_to_snapshot

Roll back a table to a previous snapshot.

vacuum

Remove orphan files older than the retention period.

Functions

canonical_json_bytes

Serialize to canonical JSON: sorted keys, tight separators, UTF-8.

redact_failure

Return a deep copy of payload with secret-looking keys redacted.

sha256_bytes

Return the hex SHA-256 digest of payload.

sha256_file

Hash a file in 1 MiB blocks and return the hex digest.

sha256_tree

Digest every file under root in sorted path order.

Rejects symlinks and special files so the digest always describes plain regular-file content. The domain separator keeps tree digests distinct from single-file digests.

load_maintenance_status

Load latest maintenance status per operation from telemetry events.

render_maintenance_prometheus

Render maintenance telemetry as Prometheus text exposition.

clear_all_capabilities

Clear every capability family from the process-global registry.

clear_capabilities

Clear one capability family from the process-global registry.

get_capability_registry

Return the process-global capability registry instance.

register_capability

Register a capability spec in the process-global registry.

configured_capability_name

Return the configured provider name for a capability type, if any.

list_capabilities

List registered capability names for a given capability type.

missing_required_capabilities

Return capability requirements that are currently unsatisfied.

resolve_capability

Resolve a capability provider by type and optional name.

If name is omitted and exactly one provider is installed, resolve it. Otherwise return None so callers can surface deterministic guidance.

resolve_runtime_ref

Resolve the effective ref for a capability from runtime routing and support metadata.

Returns None when support marks refs unsupported; otherwise prefers the routing ref from context, falling back to default_ref when refs are supported but the runtime omitted one.

routing_from_context

Build canonical routing data from a runtime context.

This helper keeps the initial migration path lightweight for existing contexts that expose only tags, resources, and the standard protocol fields.

is_blocking_severity

Return whether a severity value blocks (single owner of the rule).

coerce_capability_support

Normalize raw support metadata into CapabilitySupport.

get_telemetry_path

Resolve the telemetry JSONL path.

iter_telemetry_events

Yield telemetry events from the JSONL file.

detect_file_conflicts

Return proposal file paths that already exist in the project.

validate_proposal_request

Validate workflow proposal input independently from package logic.

Submodules

  • authentication — Built-in authentication providers for the capability registry.
  • authorization — Default authorization policy backend capability provider.
  • authorization_opa — External OPA-backed authorization policy provider.
  • catalog — Shared catalog storage for capability registrations.
  • continuity — Neutral backup-set and continuity contracts (ADR 0049 §3, Plan 011 Step 1).
  • external_refs — Validation of cross-provider asset references in merged capability specs.
  • history — Define immutable history policy and count-carrying write failures.
  • interfaces — Runtime capability interfaces used by capability providers.
  • inventory — Provider-neutral evidence for a complete object-prefix inventory.
  • maintenance — Default maintenance read-model implementation.
  • registry — Capability registry for named capability families.
  • resolver — Capability resolver for runtime provider selection.
  • runtime — Runtime context protocol and routing resolution shared across capabilities.
  • schema — Default schema change classification helper.
  • settings — Provider-neutral settings storage contract.
  • specs — Capability specs for orchestrator-agnostic assets and checks.
  • support — Structured capability support metadata.
  • support_status — Offline support-manifest capability.
  • table_store — Negotiate optional write policies without changing legacy provider calls.
  • telemetry — Core telemetry recording helpers.
  • workflow_wizard — Provider-neutral workflow wizard contracts.
